messages:
Anya: starting a short onboarding/checkin for aurora-lite-v1 embeddings. quick goals: recall@1/5/10, quant sanity int8-perchannel asymmetric, cluster fragmentation checks, and long-tail query behavior.
Tom: datasets?
Anya: mixed seed: wiki-1k, product-faq-1k, longtail-search holdout (700 queries, long and short mixes), and multilingual-sample (300).
Riley: I ran a fast local run: int8-perchannel asymmetric looks promising but cosine shift median ~0.013.
Hector: paste the CLI you used pls
Riley: `python -m eval.run --model aurora-lite-v1 --quant int8_perchannel_asym --slices all,longtail,short --metrics recall@1,5,10,cosine_shift,silhouette --out /tmp/aurora-int8.json`
Anya: thanks. scheduling a full harness on staging-gpu-2 now.
infra-bot: Deploy event: aurora-lite-v1 -> staging-canary (12% traffic). health-check window 40m.
Tom: initial numbers from Riley's local run:
```
fp16 Recall@1: 0.648
int8 Recall@1: 0.636 (-0.012)
Recall@5: fp16=0.802, int8=0.789 (-0.013)
Cosine median shift: 0.013
Cluster entropy (k=150): fp16=0.58, int8=0.60 (small increase)
Longtail Recall@1: fp16=0.519, int8=0.498 (-0.021)
```
Riley: longtail seems the weak spot; many rare queries move a neighbor rank lower by 2-3 positions.
Hector: product note 8: longtail recall matters for discovery flows. >2% drop on longtail is a red flag.
Anya: agree. also noticed a handful of multilingual pairs where nearest neighbor language mismatched after quant.
Tom: eval-bot ran the short-slice run overnight and flagged 12 examples with reduced margin between top1 and top2 (<0.01 cosine difference). created ticket ML-4820.
eval-bot: Regression summary: 12/700 longtail queries had top1 replacement by unrelated doc in int8 run. Details attached in run artifact.
Riley: hypothesis: asymmetric scale per-channel helps but clipping threshold may be too aggressive for rare tokens; will try clip_scale +0.10 and per-channel bias compensation.
Hector: can ops route longtail queries to fallback if the longtail_recall_delta > 0.02 in 30m?
infra-bot: Fallback rule configured for staging-canary: route longtail=true to baseline-opal-v2 if longtail_recall_delta > 0.02 for a 30m window.
Anya: also: add a small kd-tree radius check to detect collapsed neighborhoods (nearest neighbor distance < 1e-4). if >0.5% queries trigger, fail the canary.
Tom: good idea. I'll add the kd-tree monitor to the harness and surface histogram of neighbor radii.
Riley: starting two runs: 1) int8-perchannel asymmetric w/ clip_scale +0.10, 2) int8-perchannel asymmetric w/ clip_scale +0.20 and per-channel bias. ETA ~2h for full harness.
Anya: acceptance criteria to promote: int8 Recall@1 delta <=1.2% overall AND longtail Recall@1 delta <=1.5% AND kd-tree collapse rate <0.5% AND no language-mismatch top1 cases >0.2% on multilingual slice.
Tom: also log tokenization diffs for multilingual strings; set trace-level sampling 1% to avoid noise.
Riley: quick note: saw one NaN during normalization in a float-to-int pipeline; probably rounding underflow on extreme clipping. adding a guard to skip zero-norm vectors and fall back to fp16 path for that request.
infra-bot: Observability: tokenization traces enabled, kd-tree monitor will publish counts to canary dashboard. next health check in 5m.
Hector: please attach UMAP + neighbor-list for 50 failing cases when run completes.
Tom: action items recap: Riley - run clip sweep and post artifacts; Tom - add kd-tree monitor and token-trace sampling; Anya - monitor canary and decide promotion based on criteria.
Anya: thanks team. ping here once the int8+clip + bias run finishes and include raw recall deltas. keep comments concise. :thumbsup:
